profile.name: Vijay
profile.title: Frontend & Mobile Engineer
profile.bioHeadline: Hi, I'm Vijay. Building High-Performance Cross-Platform Apps.
profile.bioSummary: Crafting exceptional web and mobile experiences with React.js, React Native, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Turning complex requirements into fluid, user-centric interfaces.
profile.cardDescription: Specializing in cross-platform mobile apps, high-performance web applications, and robust state management.

projects.title: Cross-Platform Crypto Wallet
projects.description: Secure non-custodial crypto wallet built with React Native and TypeScript, featuring biometric authentication, real-time token swaps, and seamless multi-chain support.
projects.longDescription: Engineered from the ground up to provide seamless key management and instant decentralized transactions. Implements biometric auth (FaceID/TouchID), AES-256 encrypted local key storage, and zero-latency WebSocket quote streams across Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.
highlights: Sub-second multi-chain token swaps with real-time slippage protection
Offline-first cached balances with optimistic updates
60 FPS smooth gesture interactions via react-native-reanimated

projects.title: Enterprise SaaS Dashboard
projects.description: High-performance analytics dashboard built with Next.js and TypeScript. Features server-side rendering, dynamic charting, and optimized state management for heavy datasets.
projects.longDescription: A high-throughput enterprise telemetry and analytics suite processing over 5M events per minute. Built with Next.js App Router, virtualized data tables rendering 100k rows effortlessly, and bespoke SVG chart visualizations.
highlights: Interactive time-series canvas and SVG visualizers
Custom theme engine with Glacier dark mode and high contrast
Full keyboard accessibility and WCAG AA compliance

projects.title: Real-time Chat & Collab App
projects.description: Cross-platform messaging and workspace collaboration tool built using React Native and WebSockets for instant synchronization across iOS and Android devices.
projects.longDescription: Unified enterprise messaging client supporting end-to-end encryption, threaded discussions, live markdown preview, and offline voice memos. Synchronized seamlessly via low-latency WebSocket connection with local SQLite cache.
highlights: Sub-50ms message round-trip latency via persistent WebSockets
Offline message queuing with auto-reconnect reconciliation
Native push notifications for iOS and Android
Media compression pipeline for fluid sharing

experiences.description: Leading cross-platform mobile and web frontend development using React Native, React.js, and TypeScript. Architected modular design systems and optimized rendering performance across iOS, Android, and web clients.
achievements: Spearheaded redesign of flagship mobile app serving 200k+ monthly active users
Reduced application bundle size by 35% and cut mobile app launch latency by 48%
Mentored a distributed engineering squad of 6 frontend and mobile developers

experiences.description: Developed responsive web applications and dynamic mobile interfaces with React.js and React Native. Implemented robust state management architectures with Redux and Zustand.
achievements: Engineered high-throughput enterprise SaaS analytics dashboards with Next.js
Standardized design token architecture across iOS and web client applications
Authored reusable UI component library adopted across 4 major products

experiences.description: Built interactive single-page applications using modern JavaScript and TypeScript. Focused on high-performance animations, fluid UI layouts, and cross-browser compatibility.
achievements: Developed high-conversion single page applications and fluid landing experiences
Implemented complex SVG animations and CSS micro-interactions
Maintained 99.8% cross-browser compatibility and regression testing
